title: Tunguska as a Tesla death weapon

tellings.quote: some people have this conspiracy that Tesla the Tangusa 1908 Siberia asteroid impact was actually just a Tesla death weapon

related.note: This is the same 1908 Tunguska event, but it is explained as a Tesla death weapon instead of a natural air burst from the Taurid stream.

plain: Jesse Michels says some people believe that the huge 1908 explosion at Tunguska in Siberia, which he calls an asteroid impact, was really caused by a death weapon built by the inventor Nikola Tesla. Michels mentions this idea in passing, without naming who holds it, in an episode with a guest named Jason Jorjani. If true, it would mean Tesla had built a weapon of enormous power.
